message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine charges based on facts.

Facts: On Aug 30, 2014, Zhang blocked construction, was stopped by Wang. Zhang called his son Li. Li saw Zhang on ground, slapped Wang. Then Wang instructed workers to beat Li, causing Li light injury (grade 1). After Li injured, Wang to evade law, found Ren, instructed Ren to make false testimony of intentional injury, promised 10k per month. Wang also instructed workers Wang Jia, Han to go to police station to make false testimony that Ren beat Li. Ren was detained for suspected ... (some crime). So Wang's actions: ordering others to commit intentional injury (assault causing bodily injury) -> that's "故意伤害罪" (intentional injury). Also ordering false testimony (obstruction of justice, perjury, false accusation). In Chinese criminal law, making false statements to police is "伪证罪" (false testimony) or "妨害作证罪". Also "组织、强迫、引诱、容留、介绍卖淫" not relevant. "诈骗" not. "掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得" not. "故意毁坏财物" not. So charges likely: 故意伤害罪; 伪证罪 (or "妨害作证罪"). Also possibly "聚众扰乱公共场所秩序" not. Also "组织、强迫、引诱、容留、介绍卖淫" not.

So for intentional injury, likely "故意伤害". For false testimony, maybe "伪证". In example they used "掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得、犯罪所得收益". So we should use "故意伤害;伪证". Ensure semicolon separation.
